text:
Alex Chen: Hey team — stuck at the airport, flights delayed. Can someone swap my oncall this weekend? My shift is Sat 18:00 UTC → Sun 18:00 UTC. I can cover Sun afternoon if needed. Sorry for the short notice :grimacing:

Oncall Bot: Reminder: current rota shows Alex Chen for Sat 18:00 UTC - Sun 18:00 UTC.

Jordan Lee: I can move things around. I'm on Sat morning but free in the evening. I can take Sat 18:00 → 00:00 if that helps. @Priya Nair any chance you can cover later?

Priya Nair: I can do Sun 00:00 → 06:00 UTC, but need a quick handoff checklist. Anything I should prewarm or watch for?

Alex Chen: Thanks Jordan + Priya. Quick notes:
- Primary risk: nightly cache eviction job runs Sun 02:30 UTC — if you see a spike in latency around 02:45, restart prefetch and watch the KV cache hit rate.
- Fallback model: if the prod fp16 model OOMs, the autoswitch should kick to quantized-v2; watch for error 413 in logs.
- Known flaky path: reranker service occasionally returns 502 under burst; if you see that, toggle reranker → fallback in the route config (see snippet).

Handoff snippet:
```
# restart prefetch service
sudo systemctl restart redwood-prefetch
# check cache hit rate
curl -s http://metrics.internal/kv_cache | jq .hit_rate
# toggle reranker -> fallback (temporary)
redwoodctl routes update reranker --set fallback=true
```

Alex Chen: Also left a short note in the runbook under "weekend-prewarm" with creds and the alert thresholds. I will be reachable by DM but probably offline until I get through security checks.

Samir Patel: Happy to shadow Sat evening for the first hour with whoever takes it. I can pair with Jordan at 18:00 to see the handoff flow.

Jordan Lee: Sounds good — I'll take Sat 18:00 → 00:00 and pair with Samir at 18:00. @Priya Nair please confirm Sun 00:00 → 06:00 and @Alex Chen I see you covering Sun 12:00 → 18:00 as offered?

Priya Nair: Confirmed Sun 00:00 → 06:00. Please add the prewarm notes to the top of the handoff doc so I don't miss them.

Alex Chen: Confirmed I'll take Sun 12:00 → 18:00. I've updated the handoff doc and added the alert thresholds (latency > 750ms for 5min, error rate > 2% for 10min).

Oncall Bot: Schedule updated: Jordan Lee now assigned Sat 18:00–00:00, Priya Nair assigned Sun 00:00–06:00, Alex Chen assigned Sun 12:00–18:00. Please ack with a reaction.

Jordan Lee: ack :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: ack :white_check_mark: added a quick checklist item to remind to check the nightly job log at 02:45.

Samir Patel: ack. I'll jump in at 18:00 to shadow and take notes.

Alex Chen: Really appreciate you all — I owe you coffee when I get back. I'll DM the VPN creds and the short runbook link. Safe weekend! :coffee:

Jordan Lee: Safe travels!

Priya Nair: Thanks — see you all in the doc.

Oncall Bot: Note: if any of the updated assignments need formal approval, please escalate to eng-oncall-admins.
